business_objective: Control the recording, review, recount, and adjustment decision process for inventory count discrepancies.

stakeholder_statements.text: During a count, I need to enter the counted quantity for each assigned item and submit the count.
The inventory controller compares the submitted count with the recorded quantity and marks it as matched or discrepant.
A discrepant count must be recounted by a different stock counter before any adjustment is approved.
After the recount, I should approve or reject the proposed inventory adjustment.
This project only covers count discrepancies; purchasing and supplier orders are not included.

business_objective: Track and coordinate follow-up actions created when a patient is cleared for discharge.

stakeholder_statements.text: When a patient is cleared for discharge, the ward coordinator records the follow-up actions listed by the care team.
I take those actions, assign each one to the right clinic team, and keep track of whether it is open or done. We have not agreed on the full list of action types.
A clinic team member should add a completion note before marking an assigned action done.

If an action requires the patient to do something, the patient liaison records that the patient was contacted, how they were contacted, and the response they gave. Nobody has decided which contact channels should be available.
The discharge summary itself will remain in the existing records process; this project only tracks the follow-up actions.

business_objective: Provide a controlled review process for workspace usage overages and related billing decisions.

stakeholder_statements.text: When usage exceeds the workspace allowance, the workspace owner should see the overage period and submit an explanation.
The billing analyst reviews the explanation and either confirms the overage charge or sends the case to the service lead.
If the overage came from a confirmed service fault, the service lead may waive it. We still need to define what evidence proves a service fault.
The account manager can add a customer note, but that note must not change the billing decision.
The tool will track the review decision, not collect payment or change subscription plans.

business_objective: Control the submission, routing, response, and closure of field questions raised from unclear drawing details.

stakeholder_statements.text: When a drawing detail is unclear on site, the trade supervisor submits a field question with the affected work area and a description.
The site engineer reviews each question, adds any site observations, and routes it to the relevant design coordinator. We have not defined how the relevant coordinator is selected.
The design coordinator records a response and identifies whether work may proceed or must remain paused.
The document controller links the final response to the related drawing record. A field question cannot be closed until that link is present.
Some teams like to discuss these questions during the morning walk, which is fine. The tool should not replace drawing revision control.

business_objective: Coordinate property-damage claim intake, evidence review, assessment, repair estimates, and settlement recommendations.

stakeholder_statements.text: The policyholder reports property damage, describes what happened, and uploads the available evidence. They should be able to correct the incident description while the claim is under review.
Intake checks whether the report has the required evidence and returns incomplete claims to the policyholder. The required evidence differs by damage type, but that list is still unsettled.

For a complete claim, the damage assessor records findings and decides whether a repair estimate is needed. If it is, a repair vendor submits the estimate, but no one has agreed who selects that vendor.
Once intake accepts a claim as complete, the policyholder must not change the incident description because the assessor needs a stable record.

The settlement reviewer records a recommendation after the assessor's findings and any required estimate are present. Recommendations over an unspecified authority limit need another approval, although the approving role has not been named. The claims team also keeps joking that the old filing cabinets deserve a retirement party.
